for: HBM d4g die lead (SM tile is CRITICAL: report only; no gate, no submit)
parameter: ENABLE_INT8 (default 0: f_command = command, f_packet = packet, schedule_fault = front's: behaviour unchanged; the generate adds only wires)
physical_impact_when_enabled: packet ingress of the SM tile: +~2.7k flops + 64-lane INT8->BF16 converter + 1099-bit mux + sticky i8 fault; adds 2 cycles packet->front latency for INT8 lines only; command[116] becomes a live bit (front still sees it as 0). Master files of the die (master_files.json) must add ot_smh_static_int8.sv + ot_hbm_accel_int8_line.sv when the die adopts ENABLE_INT8 1 for Qwen.
adoption: needed for Qwen on d4g (every Qwen SM.MATVEC is fmt 3); without it the BF16-widened image costs -17.6 % Qwen tok/s (see summary.json)
